DICTATION_AI_OFF_HINT: The note is made on this computer by fixed rules. Nothing is sent.
DICTATION_AI_ON_HINT: When you press Turn into a note, the text is sent to {{service}} ({{country}}) to be rewritten. You check every line before saving.
DICTATION_CHANGED_SINCE_SAVE: You changed the note after saving. Save the changes to update the record.
DICTATION_EMPTY_NOTE: Speak or type on the left, then press Turn into a note. The note appears here for you to check.
DICTATION_INPUT_HINT: Start lines with C/o, O/E, Dx, Rx and Adv (Hindi headings such as शिकायत, जांच, निदान, दवा and सलाह also work). Write one medicine per line under Rx, for example: Tab Paracetamol 650 mg 1-0-1 x 5 days after food.
DICTATION_NOT_SAVED: The draft is made on this computer from what you type or dictate, by fixed rules. Typed text is sent only if you press Tidy with AI, and voice dictation sends audio only, each as its notice explains. Nothing goes into Bahmni until you press Save, and then only the note, in the patient's open visit. Check every line before you save or sign.
DICTATION_NO_OPEN_VISIT: No open visit: start one before saving
DICTATION_NO_PATIENT: Choose the patient first: open their record, then choose Dictate note and prescription.
DICTATION_PATIENT_ERROR: This patient could not be loaded. Find the patient again.
DICTATION_REDRAFT_HINT: To change a medicine, correct its line in the dictation and draft again. Drafting again replaces the edits in the note boxes.
DICTATION_RULES_HINT: The note is made on this computer by fixed rules. Use the headings shown above.
DICTATION_SAVED: Saved at {{time}} as the consultation note in the open {{visit}} visit. Bahmni's clinical screens and the patient record show it.
DICTATION_SAVE_MEDICINES_AS_TEXT: Medicines are saved as lines in the note, not as Bahmni drug orders. Order them in Bahmni's medication screen as usual.
DICTATION_SAVE_PROBLEM_FAILED: Not saved: Bahmni did not confirm the save. Check the patient's visit in Bahmni before trying again.
DICTATION_SAVE_PROBLEM_NOT_ALLOWED: Not saved: your user is not allowed to add consultation notes, or your session ended. Sign in again or ask the administrator.
DICTATION_SAVE_PROBLEM_NOT_CONFIGURED: Not saved: this Bahmni has no "Consultation Note" concept or "Consultation" encounter type.
DICTATION_SAVE_PROBLEM_NO_LOCATION: Not saved: your sign-in has no location. Sign in to Bahmni again and choose a location.
DICTATION_SAVE_PROBLEM_NO_PROVIDER: Not saved: your user is not set up as a provider in Bahmni. Ask the administrator to add one.
DICTATION_SAVE_PROBLEM_NO_VISIT: Not saved: this patient has no open visit. Start a visit in Bahmni, then save again.
DICTATION_UNREAD: These lines under Rx could not be read as medicines. Correct them in the dictation and draft again:
DICTATION_USE_AI: Use AI to read free speech and Hindi ({{service}})

TIDY_DIAGNOSIS_NOT_SAID: The AI wrote this diagnosis, but you did not name it. Keep it only if it is yours.
TIDY_DONE: The AI rewrote your dictation as shorthand and the draft below was made from it. Check it against what you said. Pink tags mark parts of a medicine line that are not in what you said.
TIDY_ERROR_BUSY: The AI service is busy. Try again in a minute, or make the draft without it.
TIDY_ERROR_FAILED: The AI could not tidy this dictation. Make the draft without it.
TIDY_ERROR_LIMIT: Limit reached for this hour. Make the draft without the AI for now.
TIDY_ERROR_NOT_ALLOWED: Your account cannot use Tidy with AI.
TIDY_ERROR_OFF: Tidy with AI is switched off on this server.
TIDY_ERROR_SESSION: Your session has ended. Sign in again to use Tidy with AI.
TIDY_ERROR_TOO_LONG: The dictation is too long to tidy in one go. Shorten it or make the draft without the AI.
TIDY_NOTICE_AGREE: I have read this and agree to send the dictation text to be tidied.
TIDY_NOTICE_CHECK: AI can misread, leave things out or add things that were not said. Compare every line with what you said before you save or sign.
TIDY_NOTICE_NOT_KEPT: Qorlia does not keep the text. The rewritten note appears for you to check, and nothing is saved until you press Save.
TIDY_NOTICE_SENT: When you press Tidy with AI, the text in the dictation box is sent to {{service}} ({{country}}), whose AI rewrites it as a note. Nothing is sent otherwise.
TIDY_NOTICE_TITLE: Before you use Tidy with AI
TIDY_UNCLEAR: The AI could not understand these parts. Add them yourself if needed:
TIDY_UNDO: Undo: go back to what you said
TODAY_ERROR: Today's patients could not be loaded. Reload the page to try again.
TODAY_NOBODY_WAITING: Nobody is waiting. New patients appear here when reception checks them in.
TODAY_NO_WORK: Your account has no modules yet. Ask the administrator to give you access.
USER_GLOBAL_ACTION_ERROR: Something went wrong. Please try again.
VOICE_ERROR_BROWSER: This browser cannot record. Use a recent Chrome, Edge or Firefox.
VOICE_ERROR_BUSY: The speech service is busy. Try again in a minute.
VOICE_ERROR_FAILED: Some words could not be turned into text. Please check the note.
VOICE_ERROR_LIMIT: Voice dictation limit reached for this hour. Please type for now.
VOICE_ERROR_MICROPHONE: The microphone is blocked. Allow it in the browser address bar and try again.
VOICE_ERROR_NOT_ALLOWED: Your account cannot use voice dictation.
VOICE_ERROR_OFF: Voice dictation is switched off on this server.
VOICE_ERROR_SESSION: Your session has ended. Sign in again to dictate.
VOICE_HINT: Say the headings out loud: complaints, on examination, diagnosis, medicines, advice. Say "next medicine" between medicines.
VOICE_LISTENING: Listening. Your words appear in the box every few seconds.
VOICE_NOTICE_AGREE: I have read this and agree to send my dictation for transcription.
VOICE_NOTICE_CHECK: Check every word. Speech recognition makes mistakes, especially with medicine names and doses.
VOICE_NOTICE_LOCAL: The recording is turned into text on this hospital's Qorlia server and is not kept.
VOICE_NOTICE_NOT_KEPT: Qorlia does not keep the recording. The text appears in the box for you to check, and nothing is saved until you press Save.
VOICE_NOTICE_NO_NAMES: Do not say the patient's name, phone number or ID numbers. Describe complaints, findings and medicines.
VOICE_NOTICE_SENT: While you dictate, the recording is sent to {{service}} ({{country}}) to turn speech into text. Nothing is sent while the microphone is off.
VOICE_NOTICE_TELL_PATIENT: Tell the patient that you are using voice dictation.
WARDS_NO_ACCESS: Your account cannot see the wards. Ask the administrator for ward access.
WARDS_ERROR: The wards could not be loaded. Check the connection and reload the page.
WARDS_EMPTY: Nobody is admitted to this ward.
WARDS_DUE_RULE: Readings are due when none were taken in the last 4 hours. Medicines are the orders still active; giving them is recorded in the existing Bahmni screen.
FRONTDESK_ERROR: Today's appointments could not be loaded. Reload the page to try again.
FRONTDESK_NONE_BOOKED: No appointments are booked for today.
